main_text.p: christo, aut dicuntur à S. Pau-lo de filio perditionis, nihil ad Papam pertinere: tum, quo ho-nestius in gratiam cum Ponti-ficiis redirent, eum titulum An-tichristi qui in neminem quam in Papam tam aptè cadit, in sa-cram Puritanorum gentem & Calvini sectatores & æmulos, gravi sane crimine (quod fecit Episcopus in Hibernia non ita pridem) transferrent, eoque graviori quod natio illa, seu Calviniana, seu Puritanica, nul-li ordini virorum in Anglia, pie-tate in Deum, fide in Regem, vi-tæque castigatæ sanctitate cedat. Sanè quisquis verba Canonis Patrum Vapincensium perpen-derit, non dubitaverit quin om-nes notæ Antichristi ibi propo-sitæ in Papam cadant, saltem in eum, qui in extremis seculorum deficit

page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Last line "deficit" is set flush right. The word "Vapincensium" is as printed; "tam" as printed. Watermark "Digitized by Google" omitted.
